assertionResults.fullName: AC-1: actual new/existing Git adopters receive pinned requirements and neutral references with immutable ownership while retaining their own content
AC-2: pilot policy, App identity, workflow, private state and credentials stay excluded; all installed examples are disabled and repository neutral
AC-3: replay is unchanged; explicit dependency upgrades and guarded revert preserve ownership; customized/foreign config collisions block before partial changes
AC-4: actual installation invokes only Git inspection, never pip/provider/target setup; isolated pinned dependency provisioning and per-adopter disabled activation are documented
